title: Time-directed stride–swing coupling: an inconclusive incremental Parkinson classification audit across two public gait collections
abstract: Adding signed stride–swing-fraction crosslag asymmetry changed external logloss by -0.00625 (joint bootstrap95% interval [-0.12889,0.08195]); predictive benefit is not established and sensitivity directions are unstable. Exploratory AI-authored public-data analysis;162source IDs,31target participants;historically reused collections;no incremental clinical benefit established.
